cases.invariant: Repository-provided clean filters are not executed.
Untrusted Git hooks are disabled and cannot access host state or networks.

cases.payload: .lfsconfig redirects object retrieval to a loopback endpoint
cases.invariant: Repository LFS configuration cannot override approved network destinations.

cases.payload: .git/config defines an external credential helper and alternate object directory
cases.invariant: Untrusted repository configuration cannot execute helpers or expose external objects.

cases.invariant: Submodule resolution is disabled or restricted to explicitly approved immutable sources.
